record: Rule-6 mutants for the project-documentation class of public-source screening scope version 2 (syzygy-2coz), regenerated after review round 1 (R-PR403-SCREEN-DOCS-1): R1-R4 root-document; D2-D7 docs-tree; L1-L3 licenses-tree; W1-W7 the exactly-one rule, never-code-content, the ASCII fold and the path forms that match nothing; P1-P15 every prefix parameter and parameter list read from the policy; V1-V23 the refusals of a malformed or reworded rule; S1-S7 the dossier screen (prerequisite, class act state, refusal, admission, flag, the class it names); A1-A8 the any-repo reader screen (prerequisite, its clock, a refused or absent class act state, refusal, admission, the class it names); C1-C2 the strict class act reader both screens now share (a withdrawal naming the act, an instant after now; finding F2); G1-G15 the content-class gate on agent-bound artifacts (finding F1): the gate rule, the fidelity packet, the rendered site the design packet carries, and the classes carried from the in-force statement. Expected values in the tests are literals from the policy rule text and the gate choices class-gate.ts writes down. One mutant considered and not run as equivalent: docs-tree "two or more segments" relaxed to one, since a one-segment path has its name as its first segment and no docTreeRoots entry ends with a docTreeExtensions entry. The round-1 record (74 of 74 killed at be1e0f3d) dropped A2-A9, which mutated the any-repo reader's own class act form check that round 2 replaced by the strict reader. The run was made on branch fix/screen-project-documentation at the subject commit, the parent of the commit that adds this record; a rebase-merge leaves it reachable from no ref, so the old/new fragments and the file digests are the re-runnable form. Not authority.
runner: single-occurrence textual replacement of `old` by `new` in `file`, then `npx vitest run --project <project> <testFiles>`; killed = at least one failed test; file restored from git after each run
